events.title: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.region: Athens, OH; Morgan, OH; Perry, OH; Washington, OH
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...Northeastern Athens County in southeastern Ohio...
Morgan County in southeastern Ohio...
Eastern Perry County in southeastern Ohio...
Western Washington County in southeastern Ohio...

* WHEN...Until 1230 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring. Streams
continue to rise due to excess runoff from earlier rainfall.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 826 AM EDT, Between 1.5 and 3 inches of rain have fallen
overnight resulting in flooding of several roads throughout the
warned area. In Perry County, State Route 93 and Township Road 8
south of Crooksville is closed due to flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
New Lexington, Glouster, Beverly, Shawnee, Chesterhill, Perry
State Forest, Vienna, Boaz, Crooksville, New Straitsville,
Corning, Lowell, Stockport, Jacksonville, Trimble, Hemlock,
Rendville and Bartlett.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood

events.region: Bradley; West Polk; East Polk
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
At 826 AM EDT, Doppler radar was tracking a cluster of strong
thunderstorms near Wildwood Lake, or near Benton, moving southeast at
5 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Locations impacted include...
Benton, Ducktown, Wildwood Lake, William L. Davenport Refuge,
Conasauga, Big Frog Mountain, Parksville, Red Clay State Park,
Copperhill, and Flint Springs.

events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is occurring.

* WHERE...Northeastern Roane County in central West Virginia...
Northern Calhoun County in north central West Virginia...
Central Gilmer County in north central West Virginia...
Southern Ritchie County in northwestern West Virginia...
Southeastern Wirt County in northwestern West Virginia...

* WHEN...Until 1215 PM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Flooding of rivers, creeks, streams, and other low-lying
and flood-prone locations is imminent or occurring.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

events.region: Loudon, TN; McMinn, TN; Meigs, TN; Monroe, TN; Roane, TN
events.source_name: US National Weather Service Active Alerts
events.summary:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by excessive rainfall is expected.

* WHERE...Southwestern Loudon County in east Tennessee...
Northeastern McMinn County in east Tennessee...
East Central Meigs County in east Tennessee...
Northwestern Monroe County in east Tennessee...
South Central Roane County in east Tennessee...

* WHEN...Until 1045 AM EDT.

* IMPACTS...Minor flooding in low-lying and poor drainage areas.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...
- At 749 AM EDT, Doppler radar indicated heavy rain due to
thunderstorms. Minor flooding is ongoing or expected to begin
shortly in the advisory area. Between 1 and 2 inches of rain have
fallen.
- Additional rainfall amounts of 0.5 to 1 inch are expected over
the area. This additional rain will result in minor flooding.
- Some locations that will experience flooding include...
Sweetwater, Decatur, Niota, Murray Store and Ten Mile.
- http://www.weather.gov/safety/flood
